propositions: The binding_lifecycle cluster (clear_absent, note_absent, note_absent_or_rekey) lacks integration-tier mutation oracle coverage; its no-churn/change-gating contract is pinned only at unit tier.

An out-of-window-but-alive key cannot reach clear_absent in the existing idempotency test because the fixture seeds every key in-window, blocking both call paths (binding_walk and outbound_mutation_builders).
The harness must wire the diff-phase backend to the fake transport so bound-but-absent keys' direct GETs do not escape to a real backend transport.

Unconditional updated_at stamping in clear_absent is detectable only by extending the test harness with out_of_window and deleted key sets and a clear_absent spy, then asserting no timestamp change on idempotent passes.

The 404 -> alive round-trip (note_absent records absence with lifecycle sentinel clock; clear_absent TRUE branch resets counter) must be exercised at integration tier to pin the moved tombstone-side cluster.
